# Third-party assets

- QRCode.js — https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs — MIT (`qrcode.LICENSE`).
- jsQR — https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR — Apache 2.0 (`jsQR.LICENSE`).
- Font Awesome Free 6.5.1 — https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome —
  licenses in `fontawesome/LICENSE.txt`.
- Poppins Latin 400/500/600/700 from @fontsource/poppins 5.2.6 —
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/poppins — SIL OFL, `../fonts/OFL.txt`.

Assets are served from this application. QR generation and image decoding do not
upload student details or camera frames to a third party.
